sentences.text: Billie Jean King -LRB- née Moffitt ; born November 22 , 1943 -RRB- is an American former World No. 1 professional tennis player .	World No. 1	World number 1 women tennis players	tennis player	tennis player
King won 39 Grand Slam titles : 12 in singles , 16 in women 's doubles , and 11 in mixed doubles .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)
King won the singles title at the inaugural WTA Tour Championships .	WTA Tour Championships	WTA Tour Championships
King often represented the United States in the Federation Cup and the Wightman Cup .	United States	United States	Federation Cup	Fed Cup	Wightman Cup	Wightman Cup
She was a member of the victorious United States team in seven Federation Cups and nine Wightman Cups .	United States	United States
For three years , King was the United States ' captain in the Federation Cup .	United States	United States	Federation Cup	Fed Cup
King is an advocate for gender equality and has long been a pioneer for equality and social justice .

In 1973 , at age 29 , she won the Battle of the Sexes tennis match against the 55-year-old Bobby Riggs , and was the founder of the Women 's Tennis Association , World TeamTennis -LRB- with former husband Larry King -RRB- , and the Women 's Sports Foundation .	1973	1973 US Open (tennis)	Battle of the Sexes	Battle of the Sexes (tennis)	Bobby Riggs	Bobby Riggs	World TeamTennis	World TeamTennis	Larry King	Larry King (tennis)

Regarded by many in the sport as one of the greatest tennis players of all time , King was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 1987 .	International Tennis Hall of Fame	International Tennis Hall of Fame
The Fed Cup Award of Excellence was bestowed on King in 2010 .

In 1972 , King was the joint winner , with John Wooden , of the Sports Illustrated Sportsman of the Year award and was one of the Time Persons of the Year in 1975 .	1972	1972 Wimbledon Championships	1975	1975 Wimbledon Championships – Women's Singles	John Wooden	John Wooden	Sports Illustrated	Sports Illustrated	Sportsman of the Year	Sportsman of the Year	Time	Time (magazine)
King has also received the Presidential Medal of Freedom and the Sunday Times Sportswoman of the Year lifetime achievement award .	Presidential Medal of Freedom	Presidential Medal of Freedom

King was inducted into the National Women 's Hall of Fame in 1990 , and in 2006 , the USTA National Tennis Center in New York City was renamed the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center .	USTA National Tennis Center	USTA National Tennis Center
